evals.prompt: Create a card component with multi-slot content projection. It should have slots for a header, body, and actions section. Use ng-content with select attributes. Include fallback content for the actions slot that shows a default 'Close' button. Also create a CardHeader component used as the selector for the header slot.
evals.expected_output: A CustomCard component using <ng-content select="..."> for multi-slot projection, a CardHeader child component, and fallback content in the actions ng-content.
expectations: Uses <ng-content> with select attribute for multi-slot projection
Has at least 3 distinct ng-content slots (header, body, actions)
Includes fallback content inside at least one <ng-content> element
Creates a separate CardHeader component with its own selector
Uses ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
Does NOT use @ContentChild or @ContentChildren decorators (signal queries or no queries needed)
Components are standalone (no standalone: true explicit since Angular 19+)

evals.prompt: Build a tabs component that uses viewChildren() to query tab panel components in its template and contentChildren() to discover tab items projected by the consumer. Each tab item should have a label input. The tabs component should track the active tab index with a signal and show only the active panel. Use the modern signal-based query APIs.
evals.expected_output: A Tabs component using viewChildren() and contentChildren() signal query functions, TabItem and TabPanel child components, with signal-based active tab tracking.
expectations: Uses viewChildren() function (not @ViewChildren decorator)
Uses contentChildren() function (not @ContentChildren decorator)
TabItem has a label defined with input() function (not @Input decorator)
Active tab is tracked with a signal (signal() or computed())
Uses ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush on all components
Uses @for for iteration (not *ngFor)
Does NOT import from '@angular/core' the decorators ViewChildren, ContentChildren, or ContentChild

evals.prompt: Create an AutoResizeTextarea component that uses ngAfterViewInit to measure its initial rendered height via viewChild() and ngOnDestroy (or DestroyRef) to clean up a ResizeObserver. The component should implement the OnInit, AfterViewInit, and OnDestroy interfaces. Use the modern signal-based viewChild() to get a reference to the textarea element.
evals.expected_output: A component using viewChild() signal query for the textarea ElementRef, lifecycle hooks with proper interface implementation, and ResizeObserver cleanup.
expectations: Uses viewChild() function (not @ViewChild decorator) to reference the textarea
Implements OnInit, AfterViewInit, and OnDestroy interfaces
Uses ngAfterViewInit to read initial element dimensions
Cleans up ResizeObserver in ngOnDestroy or via DestroyRef.onDestroy()
Uses ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush
viewChild uses a template reference variable string or ElementRef read option
Does NOT use @ViewChild decorator
